text:
Type: rectangular table lamp with box shade
Use: ambient light on a side table, console or nightstand; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: brushed chrome-plated metal frame base, off-white fabric shade, white cord
Colors: off-white, polished silver chrome
Shape: tall square box shade over an open rectangular frame base with a hollow center, crisp straight edges, slender and vertical, light visual weight
Feel: sleek, calm, polished, elegant
Goes with: grey or white walls, dark wood, glass and mirrored surfaces; contemporary or glam living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: TORSBO
product.description: You can create a soft, cosy atmosphere in your home with a textile shade that spreads a diffused and decorative light.
